plugins.contactsPermission: Laundrybill uses your contacts to quickly add customers. Your contact data stays on your device and is never shared.

plugins.cameraPermission: Laundrybill needs camera access to scan QR codes printed on order bags and item tags for quick order tracking and pickup verification.
